description: Zip-only blocking in entity_normalize_and_dedupe keyed candidate pairs on (zip5, first name character), so OSM Overpass records that lack addr:postcode never joined any block and were never compared against HRSA records for the same facility. The first benchmark harness self-test on clinic_discovery merged 0 duplicates even though the synthetic fixtures contain cross-source duplicates of the same clinics.
suppression_rule: never rely on zip-only blocking when any source lane can lack postal codes; require geo-grid or name fallback keys
fixed_by: geo grid union-of-keys blocking in primitives/entity.py
